verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is a hosted vector and full-text search service, so an official MCP server is a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack documents only SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby, Rust), a REST API and an llms.txt file, with no MCP server. llms.txt and SDKs are adjacent agent-friendly features or developer building blocks, not an MCP server.
